title: Safely Drain a Node
text: Use `kubectl drain <node name>` to safely evict all pods from a node before maintenance. Drain marks the node unschedulable (cordon) and evicts pods, respecting PodDisruptionBudgets. DaemonSet-managed pods usually require `--ignore-daemonsets`. After maintenance, run `kubectl uncordon <node name>` to make the node schedulable again.

title: Specifying a Disruption Budget for your Application
text: A PodDisruptionBudget (PDB) limits how many pods of a replicated application can be down simultaneously from voluntary disruptions such as `kubectl drain`. Set either `minAvailable` or `maxUnavailable` together with a label `selector`. Evictions that would violate the budget are rejected and retried.

title: K3s Configuration Options
text: K3s can be configured with CLI flags, environment variables, or a config file at `/etc/rancher/k3s/config.yaml`. Keys in the config file match CLI flag names without the leading dashes. Settings in the config file and flags are merged.

title: OpenAI-Compatible Server
text: vLLM provides an HTTP server implementing OpenAI's Completions and Chat API. Start it with `vllm serve <model>`. Clients can use the official OpenAI Python client by pointing `base_url` to the vLLM server. Use `--api-key` to require a key on requests.

title: Sets
text: nftables sets group elements such as IP addresses for matching in rules. To store network prefixes (CIDR ranges) a named set must be declared with `flags interval`. Elements are added with `nft add element <family> <table> <set> { ... }`.

title: jail.conf: ignoreip
text: `ignoreip` lists IP addresses, CIDR masks or DNS hosts that fail2ban will never ban. Override settings in `jail.local` or `jail.d/*.local` instead of editing `jail.conf`. `bantime`, `findtime` and `maxretry` control ban duration and the detection window.

title: systemd.timer
text: A `.timer` unit activates a matching `.service` unit on a schedule. `OnCalendar=` defines wall-clock schedules; `Persistent=true` runs a missed job at next boot. `RandomizedDelaySec=` spreads load. Inspect timers with `systemctl list-timers`.

title: Prometheus Configuration
text: Prometheus is configured via a YAML file passed with `--config.file`. `scrape_configs` define targets and `scrape_interval` how often to scrape. The configuration can be reloaded at runtime by sending SIGHUP or POST to `/-/reload` when `--web.enable-lifecycle` is set.

title: MCP Specification: Tools
text: MCP servers expose tools that language models can invoke. Clients discover them with `tools/list` and invoke them with `tools/call`. Each tool has a name, description and a JSON Schema `inputSchema`; results are returned as content items.
